liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Loser** (3 reviews): Jerry's guitar solo is described as mind-blowing, causing the venue crowd to go nuts; The jam is called hot, though Jerry misses notes; recording is noted as dank [23][24][27]
- **Walkin' Blues** (1 other source): Described as the best Walkin' Blues ever, featured on the official release [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-03-24.127119.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 159 min; rated 4.71/5 by 7 [1]
- **gd1990-03-24.156367.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 160 min [4]
- **gd1990-03-24.175116.mtx.tobin.flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 160 min [6]
- **gd90-03-24.sbd.harrell.12791.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 158 min; rated 4.38/5 by 8 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer stood outside in the rain by a barrel fire; tickets were hard to find [23]
- Cold upstate New York crowd helped lead the band to a metal-tinged performance [30]
- It was cold and wet outside, but the first set was outstanding inside [32]
- Reviewer stood in the fifth row for Stella Blue, experiencing chills [33]
- First night of a three-show run that formed the live release Dozin' at the Knick [25]
- Dozin' selected strongest performances; most of this audience recording is considered so-so [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-03-24.127119.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 3 Source Matrix by dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:107873) Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK SA90); Transfer Info: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) ->… [1]. Also: Date is featured on Dozin' at the Knick; show info embedded in FLAC headers [1]
- **gd1990-03-24.156367.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 8, 2022; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-X90) [4]
- **gd1990-03-24.175116.mtx.tobin.flac1648**: transferred by SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (48/16) by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (48/16) [6]. Also: Mixed by an archive.org user; FLAC conversion performed on November 14, 2025 [6]
- **gd90-03-24.sbd.harrell.12791.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > Dat x 3 > CDR > WAV > SHN [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Knickerbocker Arena - March 24, 1990](https://www.dead.net/show/march-24-1990) [36]
- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1990-03-24 Sat Knickerbocker Arena, Albany, NY](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1251622153378/grateful-dead-live-at-knickerbocker) [37]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1990-03-24 Sat Knickerbocker Arena, Albany, NY](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1251622153378/grateful-dead-live-at-knickerbocker) [38]
